Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: Brookswood is a sub-area of the Township of Langley, BC, inside the Brookswood-Fernridge community area; the Township plan name is the Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan, covering the Booth, Fernridge and Rinn neighbourhoods.

Plan-area study boundaries (Township commercial market demand study for Booth, Fernridge and Rinn): bounded to the west by 196 Street, to the north by 33A Avenue, 200 Street, 36 Avenue, 208 Street and 43 Avenue, to the east by Murray Creek, 40 Avenue, 210 Street and 208 Street, and to the south by 20 Avenue, 198 Street and 16 Avenue.

Brookswood's detached ratio of 7% is the lowest published detached ratio in the Langley set that month, and its detached inventory of 98 is the second-largest in the set, behind Willoughby Heights at 100. SnapStats publishes medians at community level only (Langley = City + Township combined). Combined-Langley context only (not Brookswood figures): Detached median $1,345,000; Condos & Townhomes median $611,000.

Parks and services: the Township lists Brookswood Park, Brookswood Skateboard Park, Noel Booth Community Park, Bell Park, Dale Ball Passive Park, East Brookswood Park, Highpoint Park, Rees-Callard Natural Park and Wiser Natural Area among Brookswood/Fernridge parks; George Preston Recreation Centre is at 20699 42 Avenue; Brookswood Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library) is at 20045 40 Avenue. Health care: Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway, is the nearest hospital confirmed on a health authority source; the nearest Urgent and Primary Care Centre is the Langley UPCC, 202 - 20434 64th Avenue.

Where condo stock concentrates: it does not — there is no apartment-condo stock to concentrate. SnapStats publishes medians at community level only, and the community here is the combined City + Township "Langley": detached median $1,345,000, $482/sq ft, 97% sale-to-list, 20 days on market; Condos & Townhomes median $611,000, $513/sq ft, 97% sale-to-list, 25 days on market. Those are Langley community figures, not Brookswood figures.

Health care: Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway — a Fraser Health community hospital with 24/7 emergency service, and the nearest hospital confirmed on a health authority source; the nearest Urgent and Primary Care Centre is the Langley UPCC, 202 - 20434 64th Avenue.

Township plans and zoning: the Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan covers the area, with Booth, Fernridge and Rinn Neighbourhood Plans under it; the Township states the plan allows previously undeveloped areas to grow while protecting trees and watercourses. Zoning is Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw 1987 No. 2500: Section 110.1 in Township council reports sets SR-1 minimum lot area 3,716 m² (40 m frontage), SR-2 minimum 8,094 m² (45 m) and SR-3 minimum 1,765 m² (27.45 m).

Pad rent (parks): where a Brookswood purchase is a park home, pad rent is governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act, not the Strata Property Act: the rent increase limit for manufactured home site tenancies is 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026 and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027, with 3 full months' notice and one increase per 12 months.

Three of the area's best-known "communities" are pad-rental parks, not strata. Cedar Creek Estates (3031 200 St), Fernridge Park (20071 24 Ave) and Pineridge (2270 196 St) all record leasehold non-strata tenure in listings and publish 55+ rules — park rules under a tenancy act, with pad rent under the MHPTA increase formula (2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026; 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027), not strata fees under a Form B.
Cedar Lane is not Cedar Creek, and neither status should be borrowed. None is counted anywhere.
The school locator cannot place the secondary school's own address. A Brookswood school claim made without a locator run for the exact address is a guess.
The guide feed and the board count different Brookswoods. The two sources measure different sets at different moments, and neither should be quoted as the other.
Zoning minimums, not averages, frame Brookswood lots. Section 110.1 of Bylaw 2500 in Township council reports runs SR-3 at a 1,765 m² minimum up to SR-2 at 8,094 m².

blocks.text: Lots and land in Brookswood
What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple lots: Brookswood's documented housing form is single-family housing — urban lots in the established streets and larger rural and acreage parcels under the suburban and rural zones. A fee-simple lot carries no strata corporation, no Form B and no strata fees.

Lot character, only: zones named in Township notices for the area include Suburban Residential SR-1, SR-2 and SR-3 and Rural Zone RU-2; read from Bylaw 2500 Section 110.1 in Township council reports, SR-1 minimum lot area is 3,716 m² (frontage 40 m), SR-2 is 8,094 m² (45 m) and SR-3 is 1,765 m² (27.45 m). Brookswood is known locally for larger treed lots — that is a characterization, not a measured average.

Named developer project, documented as built-form context, never as land: Brookswood Estates, by Foxridge Homes — a detached single-family developer project named from a developer source; the developer page states no civic address.
ALR vs non-ALR split: much of the Township's land is in the Agricultural Land Reserve. No Brookswood ALR share is stated.
The condos homes count 0 apartment condos for this area and the 55-plus home counts 0 known 55+ strata.
No assembly site is carried as inventory.
The one Brookswood presale is Bromley, a townhouse presale (above), not a lot offering.

Zoning — Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw 2500: Community plan: the Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan covers Brookswood-Fernridge, with Booth, Fernridge and Rinn Neighbourhood Plans under it; the Township states the plan allows previously undeveloped areas to grow while protecting trees and watercourses. City of Langley bylaws do not apply here.

The board-style name "Brookswood Langley" covers the identical community, plan area and land pattern as "Brookswood" — a buyer comparing the two pages is looking at one market counted once, in the land home.
Zoning minimums, not averages, frame Brookswood lots (Township council report, June 10, 2024). Section 110.1 of Bylaw 2500 runs SR-3 at a 1,765 m² minimum up to SR-2 at 8,094 m².
The Cedar names are a trap (Nov 1, 2026). The Brookswood park is Cedar Creek Estates.

items.t: SSMUH eligibility in Brookswood is a servicing map, not a slogan (Township council report, June 10, 2024). The Township's own estimate puts Brookswood at ~15% of single-family/duplex lots eligible for 3–4 units, against ~99% in Walnut Grove — because eligibility follows existing municipal water and sewer.

A strata plan is a subdivision in the ALR — even with no building (ALC Information Bulletin 09). Filing a bare-land strata plan on reserve land triggers the same ALC permission requirement as a conventional subdivision.
The R-CL maximum is a LOT-area cap, not a floor-area cap (Bylaw 2500 s.403). R-CL runs 220 m² minimum lot area to 464.5 m² maximum lot area; a "355 m²" figure appears nowhere in the bylaw.

The parks and communities

items.t: Cedar Creek Estates: Plainly: a home here sits on a rented pad — the buyer owns the home (a chattel) and rents the pad; the buyer does not own the land. The Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan itself documents this park (as Cedar Creek Manufactured Home Park) at 3031 - 200 Street, designated Manufactured Home Park in the plan — the plan designation is the official-source anchor for the park's existence and location.
Fernridge Park: Plainly: a home here sits on a rented pad — the buyer owns the home (a chattel) and rents the pad; the buyer does not own the land.

items.t: The community plan allows previously undeveloped areas to grow while protecting trees and watercourses, with Booth, Fernridge and Rinn Neighbourhood Plans under it.
Zoning ladder (Bylaw 2500 Section 110.1, in Township council reports): SR-1 minimum lot area 3,716 m² and frontage 40 m; SR-2 minimum 8,094 m² and 45 m; SR-3 minimum 1,765 m² and 27.45 m.

Transit: TransLink routes 531 (Willowbrook / White Rock Centre), 561 (Brookswood) and 563 (Fernridge) serve the stop at southbound 200 Street at 37A Avenue, connecting to Langley Centre; no SkyTrain or West Coast Express station is in Brookswood.
Health: Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway, is the nearest hospital confirmed on a health authority source; the Langley UPCC is at 202 - 20434 64th Avenue.

ALR note (Brookswood acreage edge, per-parcel only): On ALR land the ALC frame is one principal residence and, subject to conditions in the ALR Use Regulation, one additional residence limited to 90 m² or less on parcels 40 ha or smaller and 186 m² or less on parcels larger than 40 ha.

The plan protects trees and watercourses while it grows: — the Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan's frame, not an age rule, is what shapes what gets built around the parks, and a parcel's neighbourhood plan (Booth, Fernridge or Rinn) drives what can be built on it.
